# PRC Mechanical

PRC Mechanical is a plumbing and mechanical contractor in Burbank, California.
The shop is at 675 S. Glenwood Place, Burbank, CA 91506.
They do plumbing design, installation, repiping, and system restoration.
They install earthquake gas shut-off valves and handle real estate retrofitting.
They install and maintain mechanical and HVAC systems, including chillers and cooling towers.
They design and install fire prevention systems.
They do backflow certification and SCEP compliance work with LAHD.
They hold California State Contractor's License 311690.
Call (323) 245-1111 or write to prcmech@aol.com.
